components.gap: No handbook text defines a Suslin algebra (aleph_0-distributive Boolean algebra with the countable chain condition, with the needed atomlessness convention), states or proves the bound that every Suslin algebra has cardinality at most 2^aleph_1, or states or proves, with its exact construction, the consistency of 2^aleph_1 arbitrarily large together with a Suslin algebra of size 2^aleph_1. parts/p06/infinitary-combinatorics.tex:255-262 (def:p06-suslin-hypothesis) treats Suslin trees and lines only. Owed: the definition, both results with complete proofs and every cardinal qualification, from the cited Jech 1978 p.274 presentation and the proof continuations it invokes (not held).
